decisions.reason: The mitred lever family stayed on the website in 2024, and a coordinated design family fits FSB's established system offering, so it meets a modest aspiration and the firm's slack lets it carry the product despite no reported results.

Moving from a mention to a page of its own in 2024 signals growing commitment to this multifunctional handle, which aligns with the barrier-free and system-solution strategy, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search.
It remains listed with no evidence of either success or failure, and a mature handle manufacturer with slack usually keeps catalogue models rather than pruning them after only two years.
The FSB 1289 collection won the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and has a dedicated page, clearly exceeding aspirations and reinforcing the firm's design-led positioning.
